reason: A proposes a more physically plausible and directly testable route: a nanoscale Ag interlayer could improve W–Cu contact and reduce interfacial electrical/thermal resistance without introducing a poorly conducting cross-plane network. B relies on unsupported assumptions that interfacial graphene will form a continuous network, improve rather than impede heat transfer across W–Cu interfaces, and remain irradiation-resistant; its cited evidence concerns generic graphene and strength in other metal composites, not W–Cu thermal transport or fusion irradiation.
